Drop your demo clips here:

- before.mp4 — a short (10–20s) raw upload, no captions
- after.mp4  — the same clip with the finished subtitles

Both play muted + looped on the landing page, so any short silent
clip works. Then set BEFORE_VIDEO_URL / AFTER_VIDEO_URL in
src/components/landing/DemoReel.jsx to '/demo/before.mp4' and
'/demo/after.mp4'.
